title: Israeli settlers attack villages in West Bank as violent incidents increase
summary: President condemns ‘shocking’ incident in rare comment after four Palestinians injured and Israeli soldiers attacked Dozens of masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank on Tuesday, injuring four Palestinians and attacking Israeli soldiers in the latest incident of rising settler violence. The settlers attacked the Palestinian villages of Beit Lid and Deir Sharaf, setting vehicles on fire and damaging property belonging to a Bedouin community, with charred remains of cars left behind the next day.
